threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver shouts 'Get on!' as the doors close, like it’s an optional offer.
Caught the 333 last night; a guy in a full dinosaur costume tried to pay with a rubber chicken. Honestly, you'd think they'd stop at nothing!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw my Turkish neighbor arguing with the delivery guy about the freshest baklava, both laughing over the mix-up. That's Neukölln for you.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, you can find a spontaneous street performance of samba drums, and everyone just stops to dance. It’s like a city-wide flash mob on a Tuesday afternoon.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by their tolerance for the BART delays. Out-of-towners complain; we just grab a burrito and settle in for the wait.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus that stopped dead for a guy juggling flaming torches. We all just applauded when he finished. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is all about Gaudí, but locals know the real charm is in the tiny vintage shops and their quirky owners.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You'll see them fumbling with the metro map, asking for directions to places you know, but they've pronounced wrong. It’s endearing, really.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still avoid the back roads after dark, thinking it'll be safer. Locals know that's where the life is, even at night.
Caught a chat on the 59 last night, two mates arguing over whether Jerk or Fried chicken was the true taste of Brixton. Classic!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The first time I saw a toddler eating falafel while their parent argued passionately about the best kebab spot. That's when I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Kreuzberg, it’s normal to see a kebab shop next to a gallery. Art and late-night bites live side by side, sparking the craziest conversations.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Locals know to avoid the Civic Center BART during rush hour, especially now with that train brake issue. Tourists are still cluelessly swiping their Clipper cards.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 19 Polk yesterday. A guy argued with the driver about the route, then started rapping his own version of Muni’s schedule. Classic Tenderloin moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just about the Gaudí stuff. The real vibe is in the tiny bars and the locals chatting till dawn over a cheap canya.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell by their oversized backpacks and maps in hand, wandering aimlessly past the best tapas spots.
